caption: A top-down photo of a bowl of Japanese ramen with creamy white tonkotsu (pork bone) broth. Wheat noodles are submerged in the broth, topped with nori seaweed. The bowl sits on a table, shot in warm natural light, appetizing food photography.

segments_info.text: The table surface behind the ramen bowl, softly out of focus.
A sheet of dried nori seaweed, dark and slightly glossy, standing in the soup.
The creamy white tonkotsu (pork bone) broth, with wheat noodles just under the surface.
A ceramic ramen bowl seen from above, its glazed rim catching the light.
